verdict.rationale: First-party docs list distinct permission roles (owner, organizer, fileOrganizer, writer, commenter, reader). Every file, folder, and shared drive carries its own permissions resources, and sharing can be set to edit, comment, or view. The docs also state that folder access is inherited by all files within it, and that a permission can apply to a whole folder hierarchy. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of inheritance edge cases (overrides, restricting inherited access, shared-drive vs My Drive differences), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how the permission model behaves.
